_note: Fictional catalog for Lumen mockups. All names, codes, weights and prices are invented. Prices are indicative ranges; gold value uses an illustrative rate placeholder, not a market quote.

collections.Heirloom: Traditional motifs, made light enough to wear every day.
collections.Fine: Quiet lines and single stones, for the days that ask for less.
collections.Playful: Small pieces with a wink: stack them, mix them, lend them out.

pieces.name: The Quiet River
story: A single bend of gold, like water finding its way around a stone.
Hand-finished to a soft satin, with one polished edge that catches light as you move.

pieces.name: Courtyard Rain
story: Forty-two small diamonds set close, like the first rain on a stone courtyard.
A hidden box clasp with a safety latch.

pieces.name: Temple Dawn
story: The border of a temple doorway, drawn as a fine milgrain edge.
Made hollow and light, so it can be worn every morning.

pieces.name: First Light
story: One stone, held high on four fine claws.
The shoulders taper so the light reaches the stone from every side.

pieces.name: Kite String
story: A thin band with a beaded edge, like string on a kite in March.
Made to be stacked in twos and threes.

pieces.name: Monsoon Bells
story: Small bells that sway the way rain does on a tin roof.
A lighter dome than the traditional jhumka, with a seed-pearl fringe.

pieces.name: Seven Lanterns
story: Seven flat-cut polki lanterns around a single gold bead.
Screw backs, closed settings, made to be worn to every wedding.

pieces.name: Festival of Wicks
story: Two tiers of small flames, hung from a single stud.
Light enough for a long evening.

pieces.name: Evening Raag
story: Seven drops in a slow curve, like the notes of an evening raag.
Kundan set on a lighter frame.

pieces.name: Three Monsoons
story: Three strands for three seasons of rain.
Each strand clasps alone, so it can be worn one, two or three at a time.

pieces.name: Small Hours
story: A moonstone drop for the quiet after a long day.
The bail hides the chain, so the stone seems to float.

pieces.name: Brow of the Moon
story: A small full moon for the parting of the hair.
The chain hooks in two places, so it sits still.

sample_changes.requested: One 2 mm round diamond at the polished edge
